The '''Sable Dawn''' was a criminal organization which operated out of [[Point Nadir]] and various other places prior to and during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]] and the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A secretive group of [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]]-for-hire, much of the organization's activities were shrouded in mystery; even the majority of its 100 members were unaware of the fact that their leaders were a group of murderous [[Force Adept]]s. From assassination to [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunting]] to supporting terrorist operations, Sable Dawn was willing to commit any act in the pursuit of wealth and power.

==History==
At one point in its history, administrator [[Virec Xan]] was hired to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] [[Tirello Anjiliac|Tirello]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] on behalf of a [[Wroonian/Legends|Wroonian]] named [[Tis Dolan]]. Were Tirello to die, Dolan could place [[Zietta Anjiliac]], a Hutt whom Dolan controlled, into a position of leadership as head of the [[Anjiliac]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]] in [[Point Nadir]]. As a direct result, Xan was able to maneuver the cartel into a position of power, maintaining good public relations with the Hutt kajidic and the technocratic organization, [[Epsis (organization)|Epsis]], in order to preserve a new status quo.

===The Fell Star===
In his search for a mysterious artifact known as the [[Fell Star]], the [[Balosar (species)/Legends|Balosar]] thief [[Barin Trevina]] ran afoul of the Sable Dawn, who sought to acquire the talisman for their own reasons. A good number of the organization's grunts went out of their way to get their hands on the [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooinian]] conman, accosting his [[Olev Trevina|cousin]] at their home in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] and murdering the pilot of a freighter on which he'd booked passage. Trevina's employer, [[Prello Anjiliac]], hired a band of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] to locate the man and the Fell Star, which lead said spacers into multiple conflicts with the Sable Dawn's enforcers, eventually culminating in a violent rescue at the [[Evad Court]] Safe House on [[Point Nadir]]. After this encounter, the spacers fled with Trevina into the [[Comet/Legends|comet's]] mines, at which point a Sable Dawn lieutenant set up an ambush in an area known as the Fissures. The spacers managed to survive the mines and located the Fell Star, dealing with three dangerous [[Force Adept]]s in the process.
